basic_info.main_problem: 我在驾驶时感到挫败和Anxiety，这影响了我的日常生活并造成困扰。
basic_info.core_demands: 日益加重的驾驶Anxiety变得hard to bear，因此我寻求咨询以有效地处理和管理这个问题。
growth_experiences: 几个月前一次驾驶中的“险些发生事故”的经历（几乎发生碰撞），随后逐渐出现与驾驶相关的Significant anxiety与回避：在拥挤或高流量时段更为紧张，尤其在高速并线或遇到临时绕行时感到失控；尝试了听舒缓音乐和深呼吸，稍有帮助但总体Anxiety持续。

core_beliefs: I am not accepted by others（尤其担心被亲属讨厌）
我without法应对not可预知的驾驶情境，随时会出事

special_situations.event: Planning to go out with cousins or thinking about being with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I act showy, they will surely dislike me and exclude me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少与亲属接触、Repression真实的自我表达以避免被评判
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will hate being with me

special_situations.event: Needs to drive on crowded or high-traffic roads
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦交通拥挤或出现复杂情况，我就without法处理并可能发生事故
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避高峰时段和拥挤路段，开车时听舒缓音乐、做深呼吸以试图降低Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我处理not了，会发生糟糕的事

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I need to merge, I will lose control or make a serious mistake
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尽量选择not需要并线的路线或在较not繁忙的时段出行

special_situations.event: Encountering a temporary detour or sudden route change
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦出现not可预测的变化，我对驾驶就毫without掌控力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding unfamiliar routes, preferring predictable roads and times
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会完全失控，not知道该怎么办

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and understood by close people (husband, relatives) and to gain a sense of safety and control in driving and in life
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被轻视；害怕在not可预测情境下失控并遭遇危险
defense_goal: 通过回避高风险驾驶情境与Repression自我表达来降低Anxiety与羞耻感，维持表面安全与自尊

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable person who is judged and easily rejected
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、not接纳的亲属（堂/表兄弟）

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable person easily hurt by fear of being slighted
object_relations.object_representation: A partner who may criticize or look down on them

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师建议与丈夫沟通驾驶Anxiety、寻求支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者担心丈夫会觉得自己连“基本的驾驶”都处理not好，从而轻视自己（将内在的羞耻与担忧Projection到丈夫）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以犹豫、谨慎的语气强调“not想被看not起”，提出暂缓沟通或Displacement话题到实际困难上。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师Guidance其用更为平衡的视角看待驾驶风险与Anxiety时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者以“道路not可预测”为理由，强调理性层面的not可控，从而淡化情绪体验与身心感受
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use客观、冷静的语气陈述“not可控性”，减少对情绪的描述与停留。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about why he avoids crowded road sections, merging, or detours
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者以“为了安全”Interpretation所有回避行为，将Anxiety与害怕Rationalization为必要的谨慎
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes 'caution is necessary', mainly with declarative sentences and chains of reasons, weakening acknowledgment of inner fear.
